title: Dragging a pane's bar onto another pane swaps them
body: Later. With the Ctrl bar up, a press on a bar and a drag moves an outline of the pane; dropping it on another pane swaps the two leaves in the tree. Dropping on an edge to split there is a refinement after that.
close_reason: 3ee6949 swaps two panes when one is dropped on the other. The dragged pane follows the pointer as a small faded copy of itself, not the moving outline this body describes, because Jack asked for that. Dropping on an edge to split is decade-e00603.
